SELECT 
	  TMP.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
	, TMP.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL
	, TMP.CUST_ID
	, TMP.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS
	, TMP.GAM_ACID
	, TMP.GAM_BANK_ID
	, TMP.GAM_SCHM_TYPE
	, TMP.CIF_ID
	, TMP.GAM_SCHM_CODE
	, TMP.SOL_ID
	, TMP.ENTITY_CRE_FLG
	, TMP.DEL_FLG
	, TMP.ACCT_OPN_DATE
	, TMP.ACCT_CLS_DATE
	, TMP.FORACID
	, TMP.GAM_LAST6_ACC_NUM
	, TMP.ACCT_NAME
	, TMP.ACCT_SHORT_NAME
	, TMP.ACCT_NUM
	, TMP.LIEN_AMT
	, TMP.CONVERSION_RATE
	, TMP.ACCT_MGR_USER_ID
	, TMP.ACCT_CLS_FLG
    , TMP.FULLDATE
    , TMP.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
    , WH_DAY_DIFF
    , (CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END) AS CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    , (CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END) AS CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    , (COALESCE((CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END),0) 
    + COALESCE((CASE WHEN TMP.DAYOFYEAR = 1 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(P_RUNNINGBAL.TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0) END) + (WH_DAY_DIFF * CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE) ,0)) AS TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
	, (COALESCE((CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END),0) 
    + COALESCE((CASE WHEN TMP.DAY = 1 THEN 0 ELSE P_RUNNINGBAL.MONTHLY_TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END) + WH_DAY_DIFF * CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0)) AS MONTHLY_TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    , (COALESCE((CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END),0) 
    + COALESCE((CASE WHEN TMP.DAYOFYEAR = 1 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(P_RUNNINGBAL.TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) END) + WH_DAY_DIFF * CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0)) AS TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP	
	, (COALESCE((CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END),0) 
    + COALESCE((CASE WHEN TMP.DAY = 1 THEN 0 ELSE P_RUNNINGBAL.MONTHLY_TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END) + WH_DAY_DIFF * CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0)) AS MONTHLY_TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP	
    , TMP.DAYOFYEAR
    , ((COALESCE((CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END),0) 
    + COALESCE((CASE WHEN TMP.DAYOFYEAR = 1 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(P_RUNNINGBAL.TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0) END) + WH_DAY_DIFF * CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0)) / TMP.DAYOFYEAR) AS YTD_BALANCE
	, ((COALESCE((CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END),0) 
    + COALESCE((CASE WHEN TMP.DAYOFYEAR = 1 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(P_RUNNINGBAL.TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) END)  + WH_DAY_DIFF * CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0)) / TMP.DAYOFYEAR) AS YTD_BALANCE_PHP
	, TMP.MONTH_END
    , ((COALESCE((CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END),0) 
    + COALESCE((CASE WHEN TMP.DAY = 1 THEN 0 ELSE P_RUNNINGBAL.MONTHLY_TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END) + WH_DAY_DIFF * CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0)) / TMP.DAYOFYEAR) AS MTD_BALANCE
	, ((COALESCE((CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END),0) 
    + COALESCE((CASE WHEN TMP.DAY = 1 THEN 0 ELSE P_RUNNINGBAL.MONTHLY_TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END)  + WH_DAY_DIFF * CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0)) / TMP.DAYOFYEAR) AS MTD_BALANCE_PHP
FROM
    (
 		SELECT
			  ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
			, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL
			, CUST_ID
			, DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS
			, GAM_ACID
			, GAM_BANK_ID
			, GAM_SCHM_TYPE
			, CIF_ID
			, GAM_SCHM_CODE
			, SOL_ID
			, ENTITY_CRE_FLG
			, DEL_FLG
			, ACCT_OPN_DATE
			, ACCT_CLS_DATE
			, FORACID
			, GAM_LAST6_ACC_NUM
			, ACCT_NAME
			, ACCT_SHORT_NAME
			, ACCT_NUM
			, LIEN_AMT
			, CONVERSION_RATE
			, ACCT_MGR_USER_ID
			, ACCT_CLS_FLG
			, FULLDATE
            , PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
            , BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG
            , DAYOFYEAR
            , YEAR
			, DATE_DIM.MONTH_END
			, DAY
			, GREATEST((DATEDIFF(DAY, PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY, FULLDATE)-1),1) WH_DAY_DIFF         
			FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
          JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_ALLCOLS_FACT
            ON 1 = 1
            AND SUBSTRING(GAM_SCHM_CODE, 1, 2) <> '09'
			AND DEL_FLG = 'N'
            JOIN (SELECT MAX(AS_OF_DATE) MAX_AS_OF_DATE FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_ALLCOLS_FACT WHERE AS_OF_DATE <= CAST('2023-09-04' AS DATE)) MX
            ON MX.MAX_AS_OF_DATE = AS_OF_DATE  OR (DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'C' AND CAST('2023-09-04' AS DATE)>=AS_OF_DATE )
        WHERE (FULLDATE =CAST('2023-09-04' AS DATE) ) 
        and GAM_ACID='PA376535' AND CUST_ID='A01331907' 
    ) TMP
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_ALLCOLS_FACT CURRENT_BD
    ON  TMP.FULLDATE = CURRENT_BD.AS_OF_DATE
        AND TMP.GAM_ACID = CURRENT_BD.GAM_ACID
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_ALLCOLS_FACT CURRENT_PBD
    ON  TMP.Previous_Business_Day = CURRENT_PBD.AS_OF_DATE
        AND TMP.GAM_ACID = CURRENT_PBD.GAM_ACID
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT P_RUNNINGBAL
    ON  DATEADD(DD,-1,TMP.FULLDATE) = P_RUNNINGBAL.AS_OF_DATE
        AND TMP.GAM_ACID = P_RUNNINGBAL.GAM_ACID
